constraints.name: assessment_version_mode
constraints.definition: CHECK (((mode)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SELF_CHECK'::character varying, 'FINAL_ANSWER'::character varying, 'STEP_BY_STEP'::character varying, 'STRUCTURED_SOLUTION'::character varying])::text[])))

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_exercise_code_key ON public.assessment_exercise USING btree (code)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_exercise_validation_pkey ON public.assessment_exercise_validation USING btree (version_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_exercise_version_pkey ON public.assessment_exercise_version USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_assessment_version_current ON public.assessment_exercise_version USING btree (exercise_id) WHERE ((status)::text = 'PUBLISHED'::text)
CREATE INDEX ix_assessment_version_selection ON public.assessment_exercise_version USING btree (status, mode, difficulty)

schema_objects.name: assessment_guard_exercise
schema_objects.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assessment_guard_exercise()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assessment exercise identity is retained' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END;
        $function$
